stem: At same-day pickup, a pharmacist assigns duties to a technician trainee. Select all supported principles.

choices.text: The trainee can independently counsel patients.
For this scenario, the trainee may resolve a DUR alert without pharmacist review.
Under these facts, registration converts the trainee into a pharmacist intern.
At this stage, the trainee may perform only duties allowed for that category under pharmacist supervision.
Given the described event, professional judgment functions remain with the pharmacist.

related_facts: Pharmacy technicians and trainees may perform only duties allowed by 247 CMR 8 under pharmacist supervision; judgmental pharmacist functions may not be delegated.
